criteria.done: alreadySolved is true
criteria.extract: Not solved, and yellowStickerDirection is D, F, R, B, or L: lift/reorient first
criteria.transfer: Not solved, and yellowStickerDirection is U: ready to align/transfer

alignment.instructions: The preceding model decision says this yellow edge points U and is ready to transfer. Compare currentPosition to the slot directly above destination: DF requires UF, DR requires UR, DB requires UB, DL requires UL. Choose insert only when it is already at that required top slot; otherwise choose align.

criteria.align: Current top slot differs from the slot directly above destination
criteria.insert: Current top slot is exactly above destination
